about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Amazon
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, and artificial intelligence.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, největší internetový obchod na světě a největší poskytovatel cloudových služeb (AWS).

about.label: Meta Platforms
about.summary: American multinational technology company and is one of the Big Tech companies. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která provozuje Facebook, Instagram a WhatsApp a vydělává hlavně na reklamě.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Apple Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí iPhony, Macy, iPady a další elektroniku a prodává k nim software a služby.

about.label: Visa Inc.
about.summary: American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje platební síť Visa, největší na světě.

about.label: Micron Technology
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company that manufactures computer memory and computer data storage products, including dynamic random-access memory, flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory, and solid-state drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce paměťových čipů (DRAM, flash) a SSD disků.

about.label: Cardinal Health
about.summary: American multinational health care services company, and the 15th highest revenue generating company in the United States.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která distribuuje léky a zdravotnický materiál.

about.label: WESCO International
about.summary: Publicly traded American holding company for Wesco Distribution, an electrical distribution and services company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
about.summary_cs: Americký distributor elektrotechnického materiálu a komunikační techniky.

about.label: Intel
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components such as central processing units and related products for business and consumer markets.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce procesorů pro počítače a servery, který vyrábí čipy i na zakázku.

about.label: Air Products & Chemicals
about.summary: U.S.-based international corporation whose principal business is selling gases and chemicals for industrial use.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která prodává průmyslové plyny a chemikálie.

about.label: Howmet Aerospace
about.summary: American aerospace company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. The company manufactures components for jet engines, fasteners, titanium structures for aerospace applications, and forged aluminum wheels for heavy trucks.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí díly do leteckých motorů, spojovací materiál, titanové konstrukce a kovaná kola pro nákladní auta.

about.label: Wells Fargo
about.summary: American multinational financial services company.
about.summary_cs: Americká banka, jedna z největších v USA.

about.label: Flex Ltd.
about.summary: Singapore-domiciled multinational manufacturing company.
about.summary_cs: Nadnárodní firma, která na zakázku navrhuje a vyrábí elektroniku pro jiné značky.

about.label: Assurant
about.summary: Global provider of risk management products and services with headquarters in Atlanta.
about.summary_cs: Světový poskytovatel pojištění a produktů pro řízení rizik se sídlem v Atlantě.

about.label: Keurig Dr Pepper
about.summary: Publicly traded American beverage company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, and Frisco, Texas. The company produces and distributes a range of hot and cold beverages, including brands such as Keurig, Dr Pepper, Snapple, Canada Dry, and others.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů včetně značek Keurig, Dr Pepper, Snapple a Canada Dry.

about.label: Edwards Lifesciences
about.summary: American medical technology company headquartered in Irvine, California, specializing in tissue heart valves and transcatheter technologies for the treatment of structural heart disease. The company has manufacturing facilities at the Irvine headquarters, as well as in Draper, Utah; Costa Rica; Singapore; and Limerick, Ireland.
about.summary_cs: Americká zdravotnická firma, která vyrábí srdeční chlopně z tkáně a technologie pro jejich zavedení katetrem bez otevření hrudníku.

about.label: Ciena
about.summary: American optical networking systems and software company based in Hanover, Maryland.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí optické síťové systémy a software.

about.label: Chevron Corporation
about.summary: American multinational energy corporation predominantly specializing in oil and gas.
about.summary_cs: Americká ropná firma, jedna z největších na světě, která těží ropu a plyn a rafinuje paliva.

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce a dodavatel široké škály polovodičů a infrastrukturního softwaru.

about.label: Western Digital
about.summary: American data storage company headquartered in San Jose, California. Established in 1970, the company is one of the world's largest manufacturers of hard disk drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce pevných disků a úložišť dat.

about.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
about.summary: American multinational information technology company based in Spring, Texas. It is a business-focused organization which works in servers, storage, networking, AI, containerization software and consulting and support.
about.summary_cs: Americká IT firma pro podniky, která dodává servery, úložiště, sítě a cloudové a AI služby.

about.label: Eli Lilly and Company
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with offices in 18 countries. Its products are sold in approximately 125 countries.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, která vyrábí léky na cukrovku a obezitu (Mounjaro, Zepbound), rakovinu a další onemocnění.

about.label: Marathon Petroleum
about.summary: American petroleum refining, marketing, and transportation company headquartered in Findlay, Ohio.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která rafinuje ropu a prodává a přepravuje paliva.

about.label: Gilead Sciences
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Foster City, California, that focuses on researching and developing antiviral drugs used in the treatment of HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, influenza, and COVID-19. It also develops medicines in therapeutic areas such as oncology and inflammation and cell therapy.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na HIV, žloutenku a rakovinu.

about.label: The Coca-Cola Company
about.summary: American multinational corporation founded in January 1892, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures, sells and markets soft drinks including Coca-Cola, other non-alcoholic beverage concentrates and syrups, and alcoholic beverages.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů, mimo jiné Coca-Coly, Sprite a Fanty.

about.label: Johnson Controls
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate headquartered in Cork, Ireland, that produces fire, HVAC, and security equipment for buildings. The merger led to the avoidance of taxation on foreign market operations and a financial windfall for the CEO of Johnson Controls at that time, Alex Molinaroli.
about.summary_cs: Firma se sídlem v Irsku, která vyrábí klimatizace, požární a bezpečnostní systémy pro budovy.

about.label: Johnson & Johnson
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical technologies corporation headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí léky a zdravotnické prostředky.

about.label: Elevance Health, Inc.
about.summary: American health insurance company. Prior to June 2022, Elevance Health was named Anthem, Inc.
about.summary_cs: Americká zdravotní pojišťovna, do roku 2022 známá jako Anthem.

about.label: UnitedHealth Group
about.summary: American multinational company based in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, specializing in health insurance and health care services.
about.summary_cs: Americká zdravotnická firma, největší zdravotní pojišťovna v USA, která provozuje i lékařskou péči.

about.label: ConocoPhillips
about.summary: American multinational corporation engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and production.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyhledává a těží ropu a zemní plyn.

about.label: Merck KGaA
about.summary: German multinational science and technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, with about 60,000 employees and a presence in 66 countries. Merck was founded in 1668 and is the world's oldest operating chemical and pharmaceutical company, as well as one of the largest pharmaceutical companies globally.
about.summary_cs: Německá vědecko-technologická firma, která vyrábí léky, laboratorní potřeby a materiály pro elektroniku.
